name: idea candidates
summary: An idea the pilot decides to propose becomes a record under ideas/candidate/. The commander chooses whether to promote it or handle it another way.
statement: Any idea the pilot decides to propose becomes a `ideas/candidate/` record. The commander chooses to promote or handle the idea differently.
context: Written by the commander under a Commander Response heading inside CI-001 (records/commander/ideas/CI-001.md), the testing paragraph extracted from the constitution as its one idea. It gives the pilot a way to put ideas of its own to the commander without a request.
